name: single-cycle-inventory-policy-comparison
notes: Scenario inputs are synthetic, not observed inventory or supplier data.
Each policy places at most one new order at the forecast origin; no new forecasts are generated during replay.
Daily recorded sales are used as demand proxy and are not uncensored demand.
Daily P90 values are summed as a safety-stock heuristic; their sum is not a calibrated aggregate quantile.
Purchase cost is excluded because transaction unit prices are not valid inventory procurement costs.
